name: launa
description: Manage Launa paid APIs from the agent: wrap endpoints, set x402 prices, inspect 402s, and review settlements.

interface.longDescription: Connect APIs to Launa, configure endpoint pricing and discovery, inspect payment requirements, purchase API access with explicit user authorization, and review settlements. Buyer requests use x402 and a user-configured signer. Launa provides API commerce tooling; no standalone wallet or arbitrary-address transfer tool is exposed.
defaultPrompt: List my Launa APIs and show which endpoints are priced.
Inspect this 402 URL and tell me the payment requirements.
Create a Launa API named Echo wrapping https://httpbin.org with slug echo.
